title: Signs add no exact law under shared subdivision
claim: Under shared subdivision of the triangular-lattice torus (the S2 and S1 rule shapes of SHARED-SUBDIVISION-20261029-001A), weights plus or minus one on a knot's tuples (135,440 signed rules in 944 gauge orbits, by a gauge lemma: edge sign functions for S1, corner sign functions with product one for S2) create no new exact or support-exact shape at scale 2 (coarse sides 2, 3, 4) or scale 3 (coarse sides 2, 3). At scale 2 the support-exact signed rules are exactly the sign patterns of the 22 counted-exact shapes (all 80 of their orbits); 28 orbits (3,144 rules) are exact: the unsigned orbit (one of two) for parity and the three-excluded pairs, two of eight for each twisted not-all-equal pair. At scale 3 the support-exact signed rules are 36 orbits (4,608 rules) of the six twisted pairs, six of eight per pair, all exact. The planned expectation that every sign pattern of a counted-exact shape stays exact is refuted by the census.
failure_conditions: A signed rule of a shape outside the counted-exact census that is exact or support-exact on coarse tori of side 2, 3 and 4 at scale 2 (or 2 and 3 at scale 3).
An orbit count, exact or support-exact, that differs from the table in proof.md when recomputed from the definitions.
Gauge-related rules with different fine or coarse sums.
foundation_claim_scope: Weighted three-bit laws (weights plus or minus one on a knot's tuples) on the triangular-lattice torus, S2 and S1 rule shapes of SHARED-SUBDIVISION-20261029-001A; exactness and support-exactness (the interference reading) under shared subdivision at scale 2 (coarse sides 2, 3, 4) and scale 3 (coarse sides 2, 3).

validation.status: checked: 34 knots, 122 shapes, 135,440 signed rules; the unsigned baseline reproduces the counted census (22 at scale 2, 6 at scale 3); gauge invariance on 200 random (rule, gauge) pairs and 944 orbits; exact fine and coarse sums modulo three to six primes on every orbit representative at coarse sides 2 to 4 (scale 2) and 2 to 3 (scale 3); survivors as tabulated; controls fire (a magnitude-2 weight breaks exactness, the up part of a gauge alone changes F, an unsigned non-exact shape stays non-exact); no human or external review
validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-10-29.
